description: You are the HMIS officer for Ngelehun CHC, a health facility in Bo District, Sierra Leone. The monthly reporting deadline for October 2023 has arrived and the facility's data must be submitted to the district. Using DHIS2 Data Entry at http://localhost:8080 (admin/district): (1) Navigate to the Data Entry module and select Ngelehun CHC as the organisation unit (it is in Bo district). (2) Select an appropriate dataset for monthly health reporting — any available health dataset for this facility that covers October 2023 (such as child health, primary health care, reproductive health, or disease surveillance). (3) Enter at least 5 data values for the period October 2023. The values you enter should be realistic for a small rural health facility serving approximately 5,000 people — use your judgment about what constitutes plausible monthly figures for health indicators. (4) After entering data, run the validation analysis from within the data entry interface to check for any data quality violations. (5) Mark the dataset as complete for October 2023 by clicking the 'Complete' button. Save all entries.
